g.text: score ≥ 50% as set in code · says BUY or SELL · direction confirmed

svg.text: SMC library scans structure → finds all levels near price

g.text: candidate entry levels (3–10 points within 30 pips of current price)
for each entry: SL = nearest swing below/above entry
does SL pips fit max_loss budget? → calculate lots
TP1 = next swing / OB / FVG in direction (1.5× SL)
TP2 = next liquidity pool / key level (2.5–3× SL)
highest priority + fits budget + valid SL + best R:R
entry price · SL price · TP1 price (50% close) · TP2 price (full close)
if limit: cancel after 8 candles if not filled
watches TP1 hit → close 50% of position → move SL to breakeven
watches TP2 hit → close remaining 50% → log result
